title: Uma 7th Live at the Track! JFD Stamp Rally
prize: Limited Edition Special Happi Coat (Capped to 20 per day)

images.caption: Uma 7th Live JFD Stamp Rally - Limited Happi Coat Prize

notes:
Uma 7th Live themed stamp rally at Cosplay Trackside celebrating Japan Family Day! Features all 17 performing umas plus special guest Anitan.

How to play:
- Pick up a stamp sheet from the starting table No. 1 (@cookietanukiart)
- Make a minimum $5 purchase per stamp at participating artist tables! There is an exception for Table 31 based on the day: visit @syrwashere on Saturday, or @mintybytes on Sunday.
- Bring the completed sheet to Table No. 36 to claim your prize!

Prizes are extremely limited and capped to 20 Happi Coats per day, so plan accordingly!

Participating Artists: @posebean (Table 12), @cookietanukiart (Table 1), @ivoryice_ (Table 2), @boukensha_c (Table 18), @wabkuh (Table 23), @syrwashere (Table 31 Sat), @mintybytes (Table 31 Sun), @snakeberryart (Table 55), @jaxcels, @kurishay, @lazydaytee, @jellisstuff, @norcerro.
